verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any delegated, scoped access for authorized third parties such as law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers. There is no evidence of scoped API tokens, OAuth grants or restricted advisor roles. The 'control exactly what they can see' statement covers stakeholders (investors and employees) viewing their own holdings in the My Cake portal. Registered-agent notifications and the read-only MCP connection for the company's own AI assistant are adjacent features, not third-party scoped access.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
